question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

Simon ______ the contact details of renowned paediatricians in the telephone directory.
solution:
The correct answer is **"looked up."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Looked up"** means to search for information in a reference book, database, or another source. (किसी संदर्भ पुस्तक, डेटाबेस, या अन्य स्रोत में जानकारी खोजना।)

 
 
• **Example**: *If you don't know what the word means, **look it up**__ in a dictionary.*
 
 
 
• This phrasal verb is commonly used when searching for information in a directory or phone book.
 
• The correct preposition to use with **"looked up"** is **"in."**
 
• The past tense of** "look up"** is **"looked up."**
 
• The correct answer is Option 2.

 

**Correct sentence**: *Simon __**looked up**__ the contact details of renowned paediatricians in the telephone directory.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1, **"looked into"**, means to investigate or examine something in detail. (किसी बात की विस्तार से जाँच करना)
 
• Option 3,** "looked after"**, means to take care of or be responsible for someone or something. (किसी व्यक्ति या वस्तु की देखभाल करना या उसके प्रति जिम्मेदार होना
 
• Option 4, **"went on"**, means to continue or proceed with an action or activity. (किसी कार्य या गतिविधि को जारी रखना या आगे बढ़ाना)
